notes.title: Patch Feb 20
notes.notes:
Gameplay changes:

 Revamped hub area, including info for puzzle portals
 Redesigned the first puzzle to reduce chance of softlock
 Added two failsafe-mechanics to reduce chance of softlocking at drill construction
 Buffed minecart: Can now collect gold while inside it
 Sand.

Fixed bugs:

 Dying in the hub sending you to the shadow realm
 Double-cracked ice becoming indestructible when rotating
 Main menu navigation missing on controller
